steps.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library.
choices: I'm in search of a quest.

steps.text: Search the marked bookcase for a book, then read it.

choices: Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.

steps.text: Talk to Baraek in the Varrock Square.
choices: Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?

steps.text: Head into the Phoenix Gang's base in south Varrock.

choices: I'd like to offer you my services.

steps.text: Go back up to the surface.
Kill Jonny the Beard in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Return to the Phoenix Gang's base.
Search the chest in the Phoenix base for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Search the chest in the Phoenix base for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Go back up to the surface.
Trade your weapon store key to your partner. If you can't trade, use the key on them to drop it at their feet. AFTERWARDS, talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum.
Talk to King Roald in Varrock Castle to finish the quest.
Trade one of your certificate halves for the other half with another player.  If you cannot trade, use the certificate on them to drop it at their feet. They can do the same for you.
Use the two certificate halves together to create the certificate.

notes: You can also do this quest by joining the Black Arm Gang, which instead requires you to kill the weaponsmaster (level 23), or have another player kill them for you.
Once you're accepted into one of the gangs, you CANNOT change gang.

This quest requires you to swap items with another player who's in the other gang, so it's recommended to either find a friend to help you, or you can use the friend's chat 'OSRS SOA' and find someone to help there.
